accountTermination.pageDescription: Understand when and how OxSteed may terminate accounts, what happens to your data, and how to appeal a decision.
accountTermination.overviewBody: OxSteed reserves the right to suspend or permanently terminate any account that violates our Terms of Service, poses a safety risk to the community, or engages in fraudulent activity. This policy outlines the specific grounds, processes, and your rights when your account is terminated.
accountTermination.overviewWarning: Account termination may result in immediate loss of access to all platform features, active jobs, and pending earnings. Please review this policy carefully.
accountTermination.groundsBody: An account may be deactivated or permanently terminated for the following reasons:
accountTermination.groundTnCDesc: Repeated or severe violations of OxSteed's Terms of Service including misrepresentation, unauthorized use, or prohibited activities.
accountTermination.groundBackgroundDesc: Discovery of disqualifying criminal history during initial or periodic background screening, or providing false information during verification.
accountTermination.groundDisputesDesc: A pattern of unresolved disputes, chargebacks, or claims that suggest systemic bad faith or abuse of the dispute process.
accountTermination.groundHarassmentDesc: Threatening, harassing, or abusing other users, OxSteed staff, or third parties through any communication channel.
accountTermination.groundSafetyDesc: Actions that endanger the physical safety of customers, helpers, or the public, including on-job incidents or criminal conduct.
accountTermination.groundFraudDesc: Using another person's identity, payment information, or credentials; submitting false invoices; or engaging in financial fraud.
accountTermination.immediateEffectBody: Upon account termination, the following actions take effect immediately:
accountTermination.immediateEffect1: All active sessions are invalidated and you are logged out of all devices
accountTermination.immediateEffect2: Access to the OxSteed platform, dashboard, and mobile app is revoked
accountTermination.immediateEffect3: Open job postings are cancelled and counterparties are notified
accountTermination.immediateEffect4: Active bids and proposals are withdrawn from consideration
accountTermination.immediateEffect5: In-progress job communications are archived and made inaccessible
accountTermination.earningsHandlingDesc: Pending earnings will be held in escrow for up to 90 days pending review. Funds may be released, forfeited, or returned to customers depending on the circumstances of termination.
accountTermination.immediateEffectNote: If you believe your account was terminated in error, you may submit an appeal within 30 days. See the Appeal section below.
accountTermination.appealBody: You have the right to appeal an account termination decision. Appeals must be submitted within 30 days of the termination notice.
accountTermination.appealStep1: Submit your appeal request to support@oxsteed.com with the subject line 'Account Termination Appeal'
accountTermination.appealStep2: Include your registered email address, the date of termination, and a brief explanation of why you believe the termination was in error
accountTermination.appealStep3: Attach any supporting documentation, such as communications, receipts, or third-party evidence
accountTermination.appealStep4: Our Trust & Safety team will acknowledge receipt within 2 business days
accountTermination.appealStep5: A decision will be issued within 21 days of receiving your complete appeal
accountTermination.appealWindow1: Appeals must be submitted within 30 days of the termination notice email
accountTermination.appealWindow2: Incomplete appeals (missing documentation) will be returned once for revision with a 7-day deadline
accountTermination.appealWindow3: Appeals received after the 30-day window will not be considered
accountTermination.appealNote: Submitting an appeal does not guarantee reinstatement. OxSteed's decision following a completed appeal is final.
accountTermination.timelineBody: Here is the timeline you can expect after an account termination:
accountTermination.timelineStep1Desc: Your account is suspended immediately. You will receive an email notification with the reason for termination and information about your appeal rights.
accountTermination.timelineStep2Desc: You have 14 days to submit your appeal. During this period your data is preserved and readable by OxSteed's Trust & Safety team.
accountTermination.timelineStep3Desc: If an appeal is submitted, our team will review all evidence and make a determination within 21 days of receiving a complete appeal.
accountTermination.timelineStep4Desc: A final decision email is sent. If reinstated, your account is restored. If upheld, data deletion begins per our retention schedule.
accountTermination.dataDeletionBody: After a final termination decision, your personal data is handled according to our Privacy Policy and applicable law.
accountTermination.dataRetained1: Transaction records and payment history (7 years for tax and legal compliance)
accountTermination.dataRetained3: Identity verification documents (as required by law)
accountTermination.dataRetained4: Communications relevant to ongoing legal matters
accountTermination.dataDeleted1: Profile information, photos, and personal details (within 90 days of final decision)
accountTermination.dataDeleted2: Messages and job communications not subject to legal hold (within 90 days)
accountTermination.dataDeleted3: Saved preferences, notification settings, and device tokens (immediately)
accountTermination.dataDeletionNote: You may request a copy of your data before deletion by contacting support@oxsteed.com. Data export requests are fulfilled within 30 days.

disputeResolution.pageDescription: Learn how OxSteed handles disputes between customers and helpers, including refund windows, escalation paths, and chargeback policies.
disputeResolution.overviewBody1: OxSteed provides a structured dispute resolution process to handle disagreements between customers and helpers fairly and efficiently. Our goal is to resolve disputes within 30 days whenever possible.
disputeResolution.overviewBody2: This policy applies to all transactions processed through the OxSteed platform. Disputes related to off-platform transactions are not covered.
disputeResolution.overviewCallout: All disputes must be submitted within 30 days of the completed job date. Disputes submitted after this window are not eligible for review.
disputeResolution.refundWindowBody: Customers have 30 days from the date a job is marked complete to file a dispute or refund request. After this window closes, payments are considered final.
disputeResolution.timelineJobCompleteDesc: Payment is released from escrow. The 30-day dispute window begins.
disputeResolution.timelineRefundWindowDesc: Customers may file a dispute for quality issues, incomplete work, property damage, or payment discrepancies.
disputeResolution.timelineNoRefundDesc: No refund requests accepted. All payments are final after Day 30.
disputeResolution.refundWindowNote: Exceptions may be granted for cases involving fraud, identity theft, or safety incidents. Contact support@oxsteed.com.
disputeResolution.disputeTypesBody: We handle the following categories of disputes:
disputeResolution.typeQualityDesc: Work that does not meet the agreed scope, is incomplete, or falls below professional standards.
disputeResolution.typeIncompleteDesc: Helper abandoned the job or failed to complete agreed deliverables without cause.
disputeResolution.typeInjuryDesc: Physical damage to the customer's property or personal injury during job execution.
disputeResolution.typePaymentDesc: Charged more than the agreed amount, unauthorized charges, or duplicate billing.
disputeResolution.typeSecurityDesc: Unauthorized access to customer data, property, or accounts by a helper.
disputeResolution.typeOtherDesc: Any other dispute not covered above. Please describe the issue in your ticket.
disputeResolution.processBody: Once you file a dispute, here is how we handle it:
disputeResolution.processStep1Desc: Submit your dispute through the support portal. Include the job ID, date, description of the issue, and any supporting evidence (photos, messages).
disputeResolution.processStep2Desc: Both parties are notified and have 5 business days to submit evidence or a response.
disputeResolution.processStep3Desc: An OxSteed Trust & Safety specialist reviews all evidence and attempts to reach a mutually agreeable resolution.
disputeResolution.processStep4Desc: A binding decision is issued within 21 days. Refunds or adjustments are processed within 5 business days of the decision.
disputeResolution.processStep5Desc: Either party may escalate to formal arbitration if unsatisfied with the mediation outcome. See the Arbitration Policy.
disputeResolution.processWarning: Submitting false or misleading evidence in a dispute is a violation of our Terms of Service and may result in account suspension.
disputeResolution.escalationBody: If you are unsatisfied with the outcome of mediation, you may escalate through the following path:
disputeResolution.escalationStep1Desc: First level - OxSteed Trust & Safety team reviews evidence and issues a decision.
disputeResolution.escalationStep2Desc: Request escalation to a senior specialist within 5 days of the initial decision.
disputeResolution.escalationStep3Desc: Final level - binding arbitration per our Arbitration Policy. See /legal/arbitration.
disputeResolution.escalationNote: Escalation to arbitration requires agreement from both parties and is subject to the fees and process outlined in our Arbitration Policy.
disputeResolution.chargebackBody: Filing a credit card chargeback bypasses OxSteed's dispute process. This has consequences for your account.
disputeResolution.chargebackWarning: Filing a chargeback without first attempting resolution through OxSteed's dispute process is a violation of our Terms of Service and may result in account suspension.
disputeResolution.chargebackFeeDesc: OxSteed charges a $25 administrative fee for each chargeback received. This fee is deducted from the disputed amount or charged to your payment method on file.
disputeResolution.chargebackPoint1: Chargebacks that are found to be fraudulent or filed in bad faith will result in immediate account termination
disputeResolution.chargebackPoint2: We will contest any chargeback that we believe is not valid with your card issuer
disputeResolution.chargebackPoint3: Winning a chargeback does not exempt you from OxSteed's dispute decision
disputeResolution.chargebackPoint4: Repeated chargebacks may result in permanent ban from the platform
disputeResolution.faq1Q: How long do I have to file a dispute?
disputeResolution.faq1A: You have 30 days from the date the job is marked complete to file a dispute. After 30 days, all payments are considered final.
disputeResolution.faq2A: Photos, videos, screenshots of communications, the original job agreement, receipts, and any third-party assessments (e.g., contractor estimates for repairs) are all helpful.
disputeResolution.faq3A: Most disputes are resolved within 14-21 days. Complex cases involving property damage or insurance may take longer.
disputeResolution.faq4A: Yes. You may request a senior review within 5 days of the initial decision, or escalate to formal arbitration if both parties agree.
disputeResolution.faq5Q: What if the helper doesn't respond?
disputeResolution.faq5A: Helpers who fail to respond within the 5-day evidence window may have the dispute decided in the customer's favor based on available evidence.
disputeResolution.faq6A: There are no fees for standard dispute mediation. Formal arbitration may involve fees as outlined in our Arbitration Policy.

contractorAgreement.pageDescription: Understand your classification as an independent contractor on OxSteed, your tax responsibilities, and how our platform fee structure works.
contractorAgreement.introBody1: By registering as a Helper on OxSteed, you agree that you are engaging with customers as an independent contractor, not as an employee of OxSteed LLC.
contractorAgreement.introBody2: This agreement governs the nature of your relationship with OxSteed and your obligations as an independent service provider on our platform.
contractorAgreement.introCallout: This agreement does not create an employment relationship. OxSteed is a marketplace platform that connects independent contractors with customers seeking services.
contractorAgreement.controlBody: As an independent contractor on OxSteed, you retain full control over how you deliver your services:
contractorAgreement.controlPoint1: You set your own hours, availability, and the geographic areas in which you work
contractorAgreement.controlPoint2: You decide which jobs to accept or decline - there are no minimum job requirements
contractorAgreement.controlPoint3: You determine the methods, tools, and techniques you use to complete jobs
contractorAgreement.controlPoint4: You may work for other platforms, clients, or businesses simultaneously
contractorAgreement.caCallout: California's AB5 law applies specific tests for independent contractor classification. OxSteed complies with the ABC test and Proposition 22 where applicable.
contractorAgreement.nyCallout: New York applies the economic reality test for contractor classification. OxSteed's platform structure is designed to ensure genuine contractor independence.
contractorAgreement.maCallout: Massachusetts applies the three-part test for independent contractor status. Our platform design satisfies all three prongs of this test.
contractorAgreement.incomeBody1: You set your own rates and receive payment directly from customers through the OxSteed escrow system. OxSteed charges a platform service fee which is deducted from each payment.
contractorAgreement.incomeNote: Platform fees are subject to change with 30 days notice. Current rates are always displayed in your Dashboard settings.
contractorAgreement.toolsBody: As an independent contractor, you are responsible for providing your own tools, equipment, and supplies needed to complete jobs.
contractorAgreement.toolsPoint1: You must bring all necessary tools, equipment, and materials required for the job
contractorAgreement.toolsPoint2: OxSteed does not provide, lend, or reimburse tools or equipment
contractorAgreement.toolsPoint3: You are responsible for maintaining, insuring, and replacing your own equipment
contractorAgreement.toolsWarning: Using a customer's tools without explicit permission may be grounds for dispute or account action.
contractorAgreement.trainingBody: OxSteed does not provide job training. You are responsible for maintaining the skills, licenses, and certifications required to perform your offered services.
contractorAgreement.trainingPoint1: Maintain all licenses, certifications, and insurance required by your trade and state
contractorAgreement.trainingPoint2: Stay current with safety standards and best practices in your industry
contractorAgreement.trainingPoint3: Disclose accurate skill levels and qualifications on your profile
contractorAgreement.terminationBody: Either you or OxSteed may terminate this contractor relationship at any time, for any reason, without penalty (subject to completion of active jobs in progress).
contractorAgreement.terminationBody2: You may deactivate your account at any time through Settings. OxSteed may terminate accounts for policy violations as outlined in the Account Termination Policy.
contractorAgreement.terminationCause1: Fraudulent activity, identity misrepresentation, or criminal conduct
contractorAgreement.terminationCause3: Repeated severe Terms of Service violations
contractorAgreement.terminationCause4: Safety incidents or conduct that endangers customers or the public
contractorAgreement.taxesSubtitle: You Are Responsible for Your Own Taxes
contractorAgreement.taxesBody: As an independent contractor, you are solely responsible for reporting and paying all taxes on income earned through OxSteed. OxSteed does not withhold federal, state, or local taxes from your earnings.
contractorAgreement.taxPoint1: Report all OxSteed income on your annual federal and state tax returns
contractorAgreement.taxPoint2: Pay self-employment tax (currently 15.3% on net earnings up to the annual limit)
contractorAgreement.taxPoint3: Make quarterly estimated tax payments to avoid underpayment penalties
contractorAgreement.taxPoint4: Maintain records of all business expenses which may be deductible
contractorAgreement.taxesCallout: OxSteed strongly recommends consulting a licensed tax professional or CPA regarding your obligations as a self-employed individual.
contractorAgreement.1099Body1: OxSteed will issue a 1099-NEC form to any helper who earns $600 or more in a calendar year through the platform. This form reports your total gross earnings to the IRS.
contractorAgreement.1099Point1: Forms are issued electronically by January 31 following the tax year
contractorAgreement.1099Point2: You will receive an email notification when your 1099-NEC is available in your Dashboard
contractorAgreement.1099Point3: The form reflects your gross earnings before platform fees (you may deduct platform fees as a business expense)
contractorAgreement.1099Point4: If you earn under $600, no 1099 is issued but you are still required to report all income
contractorAgreement.1099Note: Keep your tax information (SSN or EIN) up to date in your profile settings to avoid delays in form issuance.

backgroundCheck.title: Background Check & Adverse Action Procedure
backgroundCheck.description: Information about OxSteed background checks, disqualifying factors, appeal process, and FCRA compliance.
backgroundCheck.subtitle: We run background checks to keep our community safe. Here's how the process works and what to do if you need to appeal.

whatWeCheck.intro: We use Checkr, a third-party background screening service, to conduct comprehensive background checks on all helper applicants. The check includes multiple verification steps to ensure the safety of our community.
whatWeCheck.item1_desc: We screen county, state, and national databases for criminal convictions, arrests, and pending charges.
whatWeCheck.item2_desc: We verify your identity using government-issued ID and cross-reference with public records to prevent fraud.
whatWeCheck.item3_desc: We check the National Sex Offender Public Website (NSOPW) and state registries to verify you are not a registered sex offender.
whatWeCheck.item4_desc: We may screen additional databases including fraud prevention services, civil records, and motor vehicle records.

disqualifying.intro: The following factors will result in denial of your application. Some infractions may be considered on a case-by-case basis after the appeal process.
disqualifying.noteDesc: We evaluate applications based on the nature, severity, and recency of any criminal history. Not all disqualifying factors are permanent - some may be considered after the appeal process.

process.intro: Our background check process is straightforward and transparent. Here's what happens after you apply:
process.step1_desc: You complete your helper application with all required information.
process.step2_desc: Checkr receives your information and begins screening. We'll send you a copy of the disclosure and authorization forms.
process.step3_desc: Checkr completes the screening (typically 1-3 business days) and reports results to us.
process.step4_desc: We review results and notify you via email. Approved applicants can start bidding immediately.

ifDenied.adverseIntro: If we deny your application based on information in your background check, we are legally required to provide you with an Adverse Action Notice under the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA).
ifDenied.adverseExample: Example: 'We denied your helper application because your background check revealed a felony conviction from 2020. You can view the full report from Checkr and dispute the findings within 30 days.'
ifDenied.adverseNote: You will receive this notice via email with specific details about why your application was denied.
ifDenied.disputeDesc: You have 30 days from receiving your adverse action notice to dispute the findings with Checkr. If the report contains errors, you can request a correction. Visit Checkr's dispute portal to begin the process.

appeal.intro: If your application is denied, you have the right to appeal. We encourage you to submit an appeal if you believe the denial was in error or if you have additional context to provide.
appeal.step1_desc: Collect any documents that support your appeal - court records, dismissal letters, rehabilitation documentation, character references, or explanations.
appeal.step2_desc: Click the button below to open a support form. Explain why you believe the decision should be reconsidered.
appeal.step3_desc: A member of our team will review your appeal within 10 business days.
appeal.step4_desc: You'll receive an email with our final decision. If approved, you can begin bidding immediately.

form.reasonPlaceholder: Explain your appeal, providing context about the record and any mitigating circumstances...
form.evidencePlaceholder: Describe any documents you have (court records, letters, etc.) that support your appeal...

appeal.successDesc: We'll review your appeal and contact you within 10 business days with a decision.

timeline.submitted_desc: You complete and submit your helper application.
timeline.initiated_desc: Checkr receives your information (same day or next business day).
timeline.received_desc: Background check completes within 1-3 business days.
timeline.result_desc: We notify you of the decision and you can start earning or appeal.
timeline.appeal_desc: You have 30 days to dispute findings with Checkr or appeal with us.

faq.q1: How long does the background check take?
faq.a1: Background checks typically complete within 1-3 business days of submission. Complex cases may take longer. You'll receive updates via email.
faq.q2: Does a denied background check mean I can never apply again?
faq.a2: Not necessarily. You can appeal the decision within 30 days. Additionally, some disqualifying factors may not be permanent. You may reapply after a specified period.
faq.q3: What if there's an error in my background check report?
faq.a3: You have 30 days to dispute the report directly with Checkr. They will investigate and correct any errors. After corrections, we can review your application again.
faq.q4: Does OxSteed look at arrests without convictions?
faq.a4: We primarily focus on convictions. However, pending charges and arrests may be considered in our review. We look at the nature of the charge and your explanation.
faq.q5: Can I work as a helper while my background check is pending?
faq.a5: No. You must have a cleared background check before you can bid on jobs or provide services on OxSteed.
faq.q6: What information do I see in my background report?
faq.a6: You receive a copy of your background report along with our decision. You can review what information Checkr used to create the report and dispute any inaccuracies.

bindingArbitration.intro: Any dispute between you and OxSteed arising from these Terms, your use of the platform, or any service provided will be resolved through binding arbitration rather than in court.
bindingArbitration.keyPoint: By using OxSteed, you agree that disputes will be resolved by a neutral arbitrator, not a judge or jury.
bindingArbitration.details: This means both parties agree to submit to arbitration to resolve disagreements about contracts, services, payments, or any other matter related to OxSteed. The arbitrator's decision is final and binding.

process.rulesIntro: Our arbitration follows these rules and procedures:
process.rule1: JAMS (Judicial Arbitration and Mediation Services) or AAA (American Arbitration Association) rules apply, whichever is mutually chosen by the parties.
process.rule2: Arbitration will be conducted by a single, neutral arbitrator with experience in contract disputes.
process.rule3: The arbitrator will issue a written decision explaining the reasoning, which may be appealed under JAMS/AAA rules.
process.arbitratorDesc: The arbitrator is a retired judge or experienced attorney trained in dispute resolution. They are bound by confidentiality and must disclose any conflicts of interest.

timeline.phase1Desc: The claimant files a demand for arbitration, outlining the dispute and relief sought.
timeline.phase2Desc: Both parties participate in selecting an arbitrator. The arbitrator reviews the case and schedules a hearing.
timeline.phase3Desc: The arbitrator hears evidence from both parties, witness testimony, and arguments. This is similar to a trial but more informal.
timeline.phase4Desc: The arbitrator issues a written award decision. This decision is binding and may only be appealed in very limited circumstances.

fees.intro: We want arbitration to be accessible. Here's how costs are handled:
fees.costDetail: OxSteed will pay all JAMS or AAA filing and administrative fees if your claim is for under $10,000. For claims exceeding $10,000, costs are split per JAMS/AAA rules.
fees.attorneyFees: Each party is responsible for their own attorney fees and costs, unless the arbitrator awards attorney fees to the prevailing party (which is rare).
fees.lowValue: For low-value claims (under $10,000), JAMS offers streamlined procedures that reduce arbitration costs significantly.

classAction.intro: You agree that arbitration will be conducted on an individual basis only.
classAction.impact: This means you CANNOT bring a class action lawsuit against OxSteed, and OxSteed cannot bring a class action against you. All claims must be resolved individually through arbitration.
classAction.meaning: Instead of joining other customers in a class action lawsuit, you and OxSteed will each have your disputes resolved separately by an arbitrator.
classAction.noticeText: Some states do not permit class action waivers in certain circumstances. See the State-Specific Enforceability section below for details about your jurisdiction.

exceptions.intro: Arbitration does NOT apply to the following:
exceptions.item1Desc: You may pursue your claim in small claims court instead of arbitration (if you elect to do so).
exceptions.item2Desc: Either party may seek temporary restraining orders or injunctions in court to prevent irreparable harm.
exceptions.item3Desc: Disputes about the arbitration agreement itself (e.g., whether it is valid) may be resolved by arbitration or by a court.
exceptions.item4Desc: Claims brought by government agencies or regulatory bodies are not subject to arbitration.

limitation.capIntro: OxSteed's total liability to you is limited in all circumstances.
limitation.capAmount: OxSteed's maximum liability shall not exceed the greater of (a) the amount you paid OxSteed in the 12 months preceding the claim, or (b) $100.
limitation.indirectIntro: OxSteed is NOT liable for the following, regardless of the cause:
limitation.item3: Indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages

ca.title: California (CA) - Enforceability
ca.point1: California law permits class action waivers in most consumer contracts. However, California Consumers Legal Remedies Act (CLRA) claims and certain wage-and-hour claims may not be subject to arbitration.
ca.point2: Under Proposition 65, any disputes arising from the sale of consumer goods will be treated as non-waivable class actions in certain circumstances.
ca.point3: If you are a California resident, you have the right to opt out of arbitration by providing written notice within 30 days of first accepting these Terms.

ny.title: New York (NY) - Enforceability
ny.point1: New York courts have held that class action waivers are enforceable in arbitration agreements, but specific consumer protection claims may require alternative resolution.
ny.point2: New York General Business Law §349 (deceptive practices) cannot be waived through arbitration in some cases.
ny.point3: You may request that arbitration take place in New York County if you are a New York resident.

ma.title: Massachusetts (MA) - Enforceability
ma.point1: Massachusetts courts scrutinize arbitration waivers closely. Arbitration clauses must be fair and reasonable, and mutual obligation must exist for both parties.
ma.point2: Massachusetts consumer protection laws may not permit waiver of certain statutory rights through arbitration.
ma.point3: Class action waivers may not be enforceable in Massachusetts for certain consumer claims without explicit, clear acknowledgment.

initiate.intro: If you have a dispute with OxSteed, here's how to initiate arbitration:
initiate.step1Desc: Send OxSteed a detailed written notice describing the dispute, the relief sought, and your proposed solution. Include dates, amounts, and any relevant documentation.
initiate.step2Desc: OxSteed will respond within 30 days. Many disputes are resolved during this negotiation period.
initiate.step3Desc: If the dispute is not resolved, file a demand for arbitration with JAMS or AAA. Follow their procedures and submit the filing fee (which OxSteed will reimburse if you prevail).
initiate.step4Desc: Participate in the arbitration hearing. You may represent yourself, hire an attorney, or use other representation.

escrowPolicy.title: Escrow & Fund Holding Policy
escrowPolicy.description: How OxSteed holds payments in escrow using Stripe Connect, fund ownership, release timelines, and dispute procedures.
escrowPolicy.subtitle: Understanding how we protect your funds during transactions

mechanism.intro: OxSteed uses Stripe Connect to hold payment funds in escrow during jobs. This means funds are held securely until the job is complete, protecting both customers and helpers.
mechanism.keyPoint: Funds are held BY Stripe, not by OxSteed. We facilitate the holding only.
mechanism.details: When you make a payment for a job, the funds are authorized on your payment method and held in Stripe's secure system. OxSteed does not have direct access to or control of these funds.
mechanism.stripe: Stripe is a leading payment processor trusted by thousands of businesses worldwide. They are PCI-DSS compliant and maintain the highest security standards for payment processing.

authorization.intro: By posting a job and proceeding to payment, you authorize the escrow process.
authorization.byChoosingDesc: You agree that OxSteed and Stripe may hold your payment funds according to these terms until the job is marked complete or the dispute is resolved.
authorization.details: You will receive a confirmation email showing the authorization amount, job details, and timeline for fund release. You can cancel the payment before the job begins.

ownership.intro: It's important to understand who owns the funds during escrow.
ownership.item1Desc: Until the job is complete and funds are released, the money belongs to the customer (the person who made the payment). The helper has no claim to the funds until the job is complete.
ownership.item2Desc: OxSteed does not own, control, or have access to escrowed funds. We facilitate the process but remain a neutral third party.
ownership.item3Desc: Stripe holds the funds in a secure, segregated account. The funds cannot be accessed by OxSteed, the helper, or anyone else until the proper conditions are met.
ownership.disclaimerDesc: Escrowed funds are NOT insured by the FDIC or any government agency. However, Stripe maintains the highest security standards to prevent loss or theft.

liability.intro: OxSteed is not responsible for certain issues related to fund holding.
liability.serviceInterruptionDesc: If Stripe experiences downtime or service disruptions, resulting in delays to fund release, OxSteed is not liable. Stripe maintains 99.99% uptime guarantees.
liability.securityDesc: If Stripe's systems are compromised or funds are lost due to security breach (extremely rare), OxSteed is not liable. Your recourse would be through Stripe and their insurance.
liability.recoveryDesc: OxSteed will assist in investigating and reporting any issues to Stripe, but we cannot recover lost or misappropriated funds directly.

release.jobCompletionDesc: Funds are released 3 business days after the customer marks the job as complete. This gives the customer time to verify the work quality before the helper receives payment.
release.timeline: Release Timeline: 3 business days after job completion. Funds arrive in helper's account: 5-7 business days from release.
release.refundDesc: If a customer requests a refund before the job is complete, the funds are returned to their original payment method per Stripe's refund policies.
release.processingTimeDesc: Refunds are issued within 5-7 business days of approval. Processing times vary by bank and payment method (credit card, debit card, bank account, etc.).
release.disputeDesc: If there is a dispute about job completion, funds remain in escrow while the dispute is investigated. See our Dispute Resolution page for details.

timeline.authorizedDesc: Customer's payment is authorized and placed in escrow with Stripe.
timeline.completedDesc: Customer marks the job as complete after the helper finishes work.
timeline.releasedDesc: Funds are released from escrow to the helper's OxSteed account 3 business days after completion.
timeline.receivedDesc: Funds arrive in helper's bank account or payment method 5-7 business days later.

notices.chargebackDesc: If you initiate a chargeback with your credit card company instead of using OxSteed's dispute process, it bypasses our escrow protection. Chargebacks are expensive and disrupt the dispute process.
notices.chargebackFee: Per Stripe's terms, chargebacks incur a $25 fee per transaction. Please use our dispute process instead.
notices.legalHoldDesc: If OxSteed receives a legal order, subpoena, or court order regarding funds in escrow, those funds may be frozen and held pending legal resolution. OxSteed will notify you if this occurs.

faq.q1: Can I cancel a payment after it's authorized?
faq.a1: Yes. Before the helper starts work, you can cancel the job and your payment will be refunded to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.
faq.q2: What if the helper doesn't complete the job?
faq.a2: If the job is not completed or the customer is unsatisfied, they can open a dispute. OxSteed reviews disputes and either releases funds to the helper or refunds the customer.
faq.q3: How long does it take to get paid as a helper?
faq.a3: After the customer marks the job complete, funds are released 3 business days later, then take 5-7 business days to appear in your bank account (10 business days total).
faq.q4: What if Stripe holds my funds for some reason?
faq.a4: Stripe may hold funds temporarily for verification purposes. If this happens, contact support@oxsteed.com and we will follow up with Stripe on your behalf.
faq.q5: Can I get my funds released early?
faq.a5: No. The 3-day escrow hold is fixed per Stripe's policies and OxSteed's payment terms. This protects both customers and helpers.
faq.q6: What happens if I have a dispute?
faq.a6: If you dispute a job, funds remain in escrow while we investigate. See our Dispute Resolution policy for full details on the process and timeline.
faq.q7: Is my money safe in escrow?
faq.a7: Yes. Stripe uses bank-level encryption and security measures. However, escrow funds are not FDIC insured. Stripe maintains 99.99% uptime and has never lost customer funds due to security issues.
faq.q8: What if OxSteed shuts down - what happens to escrowed funds?
faq.a8: If OxSteed ceases operations, funds in escrow remain the property of their rightful owners (customers and helpers). Stripe would work with OxSteed's receivers to distribute funds according to the contracts.

howItWorks.title: How OxSteed Works
howItWorks.subtitle: OxSteed connects customers with local helpers. Whether you need work done or want to earn money in your community, we make it simple and easy to use.
howItWorks.faqSubtitle: Quick answers to what most people ask about OxSteed.
howItWorks.readySubtitle: Join your local OxSteed community today. It only takes a couple of minutes.
howItWorks.customerStep1Desc: Sign up in about 5 minutes. No credit card required.
howItWorks.customerStep2Desc: Describe what you need - handyman work, cleaning, yard work, moving help, and more. Set your budget and timeline.
howItWorks.customerStep3Desc: Qualified local helpers see your job and send competitive bids. Compare profiles, ratings, and pricing side by side.
howItWorks.customerStep4Desc: Choose the best fit, communicate through our messaging system, and get the job done. Leave a review when complete.
howItWorks.helperStep2Desc: See real jobs posted by customers in your area. Submit competitive bids and showcase your experience.
howItWorks.helperStep3Desc: Win jobs, complete the work, and build your reputation with reviews. Grow your local business on your schedule.
howItWorks.faq1A: Yes. Posting jobs as a customer is completely free. All users can sign up at no cost and bid on a limited number of jobs per month, or upgrade to a paid plan for expanded access.
howItWorks.faq2Q: How does OxSteed verify its users?
howItWorks.faq2A: Every user completes identity verification during registration. We may also run background checks and collect tax information (such as a W-9) when a user chooses to receive payment via OxSteed. Customer reviews further build each helper's reputation over time.
howItWorks.faq3Q: What types of jobs can I post?
howItWorks.faq3A: Handyman, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, moving, painting, landscaping, yard work, tool rental, general labor, and more. If it's a local service task, you can post it on OxSteed.
howItWorks.faq4Q: How do I communicate with a helper or customer?
howItWorks.faq4A: Once a bid is accepted, both parties can message each other securely through OxSteed's built-in messaging system without the need to share personal phone numbers.
howItWorks.faq5A: OxSteed is a marketplace that connects customers with independent business owners and does not control how individual jobs are performed or paid for. If there's an issue with a job, either party can open a case in our dispute resolution center, and our team will try to help mediate a fair outcome when possible.

upgrade.helperSubtitle: Get verified, unlock priority placement, and start earning more with Pro.
upgrade.customerSubtitle: Unlock budget tracking, goal setting, saved helpers, and the full life dashboard.
upgrade.forCustomersDesc: Complete ID verification to unlock protected payments. Your money is secure until the job is done.
upgrade.forHelpersDesc: Complete ID verification, background check, and set up your Stripe Express account to accept protected payments.
upgrade.cancelConfirm: Are you sure you want to cancel? You'll keep access until the end of your billing period.
upgrade.faq1A: Pro gives you a verified badge, the ability to submit bids on jobs, priority search placement, background check eligibility, identity verification, push notifications for urgent jobs, and the full Life Dashboard with budget tracking, goals, home maintenance reminders, and community insights.
upgrade.faq2A: Yes, you can cancel your Pro subscription at any time. You'll keep access to all Pro features until the end of your current billing period. No cancellation fees.
upgrade.faq3A: OxSteed Protection is our secure payment system powered by Stripe. When a customer and helper agree on a job, the payment is processed through Stripe Connect. OxSteed takes a 7.1% platform fee (minimum $5), and the helper receives the rest minus Stripe's standard processing fees. This isn't a subscription - it's a per-transaction fee that only applies when you use OxSteed Protection for a job.
upgrade.faq4Q: How much does the helper actually receive?
upgrade.faq4A: On a $200 job, OxSteed takes $14.20 (7.1%) and Stripe's processing fee is approximately $6.10 (2.9% + $0.30). The helper receives approximately $179.70. The helper is the merchant of record - payments go directly to their Stripe Express account.
upgrade.faq5Q: Do I need Pro to use OxSteed Protection?
upgrade.faq5A: OxSteed Protection is available to all verified users - both Free and Pro. However, Pro helpers have priority placement which means more job opportunities, and the verified badge builds more trust with customers.
upgrade.faq6Q: What's the difference between monthly and yearly?
upgrade.faq6A: Monthly is ${{monthly}}/month. Yearly is ${{yearly}}/year - that's ${{perMonth}}/month, saving you ${{savings}} per year ({{pct}}% off).
upgrade.faq7A: Absolutely. All payments are processed through Stripe, a PCI Level 1 certified payment processor. OxSteed never stores your credit card information.
upgrade.proF8: Full Life Dashboard - budgets, goals, tracking
upgrade.protectionDesc: When you use OxSteed Protection, payments are processed securely through Stripe. The customer pays the agreed job price, and OxSteed takes a simple 7.1% platform fee (minimum $5). That's it - one transparent fee that covers payment processing, dispute mediation, and platform support.

mission.invisibleTitle: Too many skilled people stay invisible
mission.invisibleDesc: Millions of people know how to clean, repair, move, install, organize, teach, drive, cook, and solve problems. But knowing how to do something and knowing how to turn it into a business are not the same.
mission.ownershipTitle: We believe ownership should be reachable
mission.ownershipDesc: Not everyone starts with capital, connections, or business training. But many people already have something valuable: a skill that solves real problems. OxSteed exists to help people start there. The mission is simple: give regular people the opportunity to go from knowing how to do something to owning their own business in the long term.

Along the way, they're not alone - they're part of a growing network of people doing the same.

howOxsteedWorks.metaDescription: Learn how OxSteed works for customers, helpers, businesses, and tool owners. Explore jobs, bookings, tools, payments, planned needs, messages, disputes, dashboards, and business growth features.
howOxsteedWorks.title: One connected system for getting help, doing work, renting tools, and running a local business.
howOxsteedWorks.subtitle: OxSteed is part marketplace, part life command center, and part business operating system. This page combines the simple how-it-works path with a detailed feature guide so new users can understand what to do next.

customers.label: For customers
customers.title: Get help without losing the thread
steps: Describe a job, planned need, booking, or tool rental.
Compare helpers, quotes, messages, schedule, and trust signals.
Pay, review, remember, and plan the next need from your dashboard.

Use Business Hub, analytics, templates, consulting, and support to grow.

mentalModel.title: The simple mental model
mentalModel.body: OxSteed connects four things users usually manage separately: needs, people, money, and time. A need can become a job. A job can create messages, appointments, payments, reviews, and reminders. A completed service can become a recurring planned need. A helper can become a saved preferred helper. The dashboard pulls those signals back into one view so the user knows what to do next.

doNotSellPage.doesNotSellText1: لا تبيع OxSteed LLC أو تؤجر أو تتبادل أو تفصح عن معلوماتك الشخصية لطرف ثالث لقاء مقابل مادي أو منفعة قيمة أخرى. نحن لا نشارك معلوماتك الشخصية مع طرف ثالث لأغراض الإعلانات السلوكية عبر سياقات متعددة.
doNotSellPage.doesNotSellText2: بما أننا لا نبيع أو نشارك المعلومات الشخصية كما هو محدد في CCPA/CPRA، فلا يلزم اتخاذ أي إجراء من جانبك. ومع ذلك، إذا تغيّر قانون كاليفورنيا أو تغيّرت ممارساتنا، سيتم تحديث هذه الصفحة وفقًا لذلك.
doNotSellPage.rightsItem1: اعرف ما هي المعلومات الشخصية التي يتم جمعها وكيف تستخدم.
doNotSellPage.rightsItem3: اختر الانسحاب من بيع أو مشاركة المعلومات الشخصية (غير مطبق لأننا لا نبيع أو نشارك).
doNotSellPage.rightsItem4: عدم التمييز عند ممارسة حقوق الخصوصية.
doNotSellPage.otherStateLawsText: كما تحترم OxSteed حقوق الخصوصية وفقًا لقانون حماية بيانات المستهلك في فرجينيا (VCDPA) وقانون خصوصية كولورادو (CPA) وقانون خصوصية بيانات كونيتيكت (CTDPA) وغيرها من قوانين الخصوصية المعمول بها في الولايات الأخرى. إذا كنت مقيماً في أي من هذه الولايات، يمكنك ممارسة حقوقك عبر التواصل معنا على العنوان أدناه.
doNotSellPage.contactIntro: إذا كانت لديك أسئلة حول هذه الصفحة أو كنت ترغب في ممارسة أي من حقوق الخصوصية، يرجى الاتصال بنا على:

cookiePolicyPage.title: سياسة ملفات تعريف الارتباط
cookiePolicyPage.section1Text: ملفات تعريف الارتباط هي ملفات نصية صغيرة تُخزن على جهازك عند زيارة موقع ويب. تساعدنا على تذكر تفضيلاتك وفهم كيفية استخدامك للمنصة وتحسين تجربتك.
cookiePolicyPage.section2Title: 2. كيف تستخدم OxSteed ملفات تعريف الارتباط
cookiePolicyPage.section2Text: تستخدم OxSteed ملفات تعريف الارتباط والتقنيات المشابهة (localStorage، sessionStorage) لتشغيل المنصة وتحليل الاستخدام وتقديم محتوى ملائم.
cookiePolicyPage.section3Title: 3. أنواع ملفات تعريف الارتباط التي نستخدمها
cookiePolicyPage.tableEssentialPurpose: رموز أمان، رموز المصادقة، حماية CSRF، وإدارة الجلسة

cookiePolicyPage.tableFunctionalPurpose: تفضيلات محفوظة، عناصر دردشة، إعدادات اللغة
cookiePolicyPage.section4Text: عند زيارتك الأولى لـ OxSteed، سيعرض شعار ملفات تعريف الارتباط طلبًا للموافقة. يمكنك:
cookiePolicyPage.section4Choice1: قبول الكل - تفعيل جميع فئات ملفات تعريف الارتباط
cookiePolicyPage.section4Choice2: رفض الكل - سيتم استخدام ملفات الارتباط الأساسية فقط
cookiePolicyPage.section4Choice3: تخصيص - اختر الفئات التي تريد تفعيلها
cookiePolicyPage.section4Footer: يمكنك تغيير تفضيلاتك في أي وقت بالنقر على
cookiePolicyPage.section5Text: معظم المتصفحات تسمح لك بحظر أو حذف ملفات تعريف الارتباط عبر الإعدادات. لاحظ أن حظر ملفات الارتباط الأساسية قد يعرقل عمل OxSteed بشكل صحيح.
cookiePolicyPage.section6Title: 6. ملفات تعريف الارتباط من جهات خارجية
cookiePolicyPage.section6Text: بعض ملفات الارتباط يتم تعيينها بواسطة خدمات طرف ثالث تظهر في صفحاتنا. نحن لا نتحكم في هذه الملفات. الجهات الخارجية الرئيسية تشمل:
cookiePolicyPage.section7Text: تلتزم OxSteed بإشارات DNT في المتصفحات. عند اكتشافها، نعطل ملفات التعريف غير الأساسية تلقائيًا.
cookiePolicyPage.section8Text: تحت CCPA، لديك الحق في رفض بيع معلوماتك الشخصية. إذا تم تفعيل ملفات تعريف الارتباط التسويقية في المستقبل، فقد تشكل "بيعًا" بموجب CCPA. قم بزيارة
cookiePolicyPage.section9Text: قد نقوم بتحديث سياسة ملفات تعريف الارتباط هذه بشكل دوري. سيتم نشر التغييرات في هذه الصفحة مع تاريخ سريان محدث. استمرار استخدامك لـ OxSteed بعد التغييرات يعني قبولك.

securityPolicyPage.title: سياسة الأمان
securityPolicyPage.section1Text: تأخذ OxSteed LLC أمن معلوماتك الشخصية بجدية. نحن نطبق ضوابط إدارية وتقنية ومادية ذات معنى لحماية بياناتك من الوصول غير المصرح به أو التعديل أو الكشف أو الإتلاف.
securityPolicyPage.section2List1: التشفير أثناء النقل: جميع البيانات المرسلة بين متصفحك وخوادم OxSteed مشفرة باستخدام TLS 1.2+ (HTTPS).
securityPolicyPage.section2List2: أمن كلمات المرور: تُشفّر كلمات المرور باستخدام bcrypt مع أملاح فريدة لكل مستخدم. لا يستطيع موظفو OxSteed رؤية كلمات مرورك.
securityPolicyPage.section2List3: المصادقة: اعتماد JWT مع ملفات تعريف ارتباط آمنة وغير قابلة للوصول عبر JavaScript. الرموز تنتهي وتُجدّد تلقائيًا.
securityPolicyPage.section2List4: المصادقة الثنائية: TOTP اختياري عبر تطبيقات المصادقة لحماية الحساب.
securityPolicyPage.section2List5: تحديد المعدل: نقاط النهاية الخاصة بالمصادقة محدودة بالسرعة لمنع هجمات القوة العنيفة.
securityPolicyPage.section2List6: التحكم حسب الدور: المستخدمون يمكنهم الوصول فقط للبيانات والميزات الملائمة لدورهم (عميل، مساعد، مسؤول).
securityPolicyPage.section2List7: تحقق الإدخال: جميع الإدخالات تتحقق وتُنقّى على جانب الخادم لمنع هجمات الحقن.
securityPolicyPage.section2List8: رؤوس الحماية: تُستخدم مكتبة Helmet.js لإعداد رؤوس أمان HTTP مثل CSP وHSTS وX-Frame-Options وX-Content-Type-Options.
securityPolicyPage.section3List1: Stripe: تتم جميع عمليات الدفع عبر Stripe, Inc. وهي معتمدة PCI DSS من المستوى 1. لا تحتفظ OxSteed بأرقام بطاقات الائتمان.
securityPolicyPage.section3List2: Checkr: تتم معالجة وتخزين بيانات فحص الخلفية لدى Checkr, Inc. وفق سياسات أمانه الخاصة ومتطلبات FCRA.
securityPolicyPage.section3List3: Render: تستضيف خوادمنا على بنية Render مع TLS تلقائيًا، حماية من هجمات DDoS، وبيئات معزولة.
securityPolicyPage.section3List4: Resend: تُرسل رسائل البريد الإلكتروني عبر Resend مع تشفير TLS.
securityPolicyPage.section4Text: إذا اكتشفت ثغرة أمنية على OxSteed، نطلب منك الإبلاغ عنها بشكل مسؤول. يرجى الإبلاغ عبر:
securityPolicyPage.section4Include3: أي لقطات شاشة أو كود توضيحي ذات صلة;
securityPolicyPage.section4Response: سنعترف باستلام تقريرك خلال 48 ساعة وسنعمل على حل الثغرات المؤكدة في أسرع وقت. لن نتخذ إجراءً قانونيًا ضد الباحثين الذين يتبعون ممارسات الإبلاغ المسؤول.
securityPolicyPage.section4DoNot: لا تصل إلى حسابات أو بيانات مستخدمين آخرين، ولا تنفذ هجمات إنكار الخدمة، ولا تستغل الثغرات أكثر مما يلزم لإظهار المشكلة.
securityPolicyPage.section5List1: استخدم كلمة مرور قوية وفريدة لحساب OxSteed الخاص بك.
securityPolicyPage.section5List2: فعّل المصادقة الثنائية للحماية الإضافية للحساب.
securityPolicyPage.section5List3: لا تشارك بيانات تسجيل الدخول مع أي شخص.
securityPolicyPage.section5List4: سجل الخروج من حسابك عند استخدام أجهزة مشتركة أو عامة.
securityPolicyPage.section5List5: أبلغنا فورًا إذا اشتبهت في وصول غير مصرح به إلى حسابك.
securityPolicyPage.section5List6: حافظ على تحديث متصفحك ونظام التشغيل.
securityPolicyPage.section6Text: في حال وقوع حادث أمني يهدد البيانات الشخصية، ستتبع OxSteed الخطوات التالية:
securityPolicyPage.section6List2: إخطار المستخدمين المتأثرين عبر البريد الإلكتروني خلال 72 ساعة.
